Package frc.robot.util

Class AllianceUtil.AllianceCell

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.util.AllianceUtil.AllianceCell
Enclosing class:
AllianceUtil
public static class AllianceUtil.AllianceCell extends Object
A container for the current alliance state with caching.

This inner class caches the alliance once it's reported by FMS to avoid repeated queries and handles the case where alliance information might not be immediately available.

  • Method Details

    • get

      public edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.DriverStation.Alliance get()
      Gets the current alliance, with fallback to cached value.

      Queries FMS for the current alliance and caches the result. If FMS hasn't reported yet and no prior value is cached, defaults to Blue and logs a warning.

      Returns:
      The current alliance (Blue or Red)

    • invert
